01In some cases, wastewater, rainwater or groundwater cannot be drained from a plot…

In some cases, wastewater, rainwater or groundwater cannot be drained from a plot by gravity, without the use of pumping technology. For these cases we offer the complete range of pump shafts from ASIO.

A pumping station is usually installed in the ground near municipal buildings, or in the service floors or basements of buildings, standing free on the floor. The installation of a pumping sump also includes a signalling system that warns of any complications and operating problems at the station (light signal, SMS alert, warning beacon).

02AS-PUMP pumping stations are very robust; they are made of solid polypropylene, or alternatively concrete, which…

AS-PUMP pumping stations are very robust; they are made of solid polypropylene, or alternatively concrete, which provides chemical as well as mechanical resistance. They are not, however, suitable for pumping liquids of flammability classes I and II. On the other hand, if you need a pumping station for food-industry purposes, we can supply one on request with a certificate confirming that it is hygienically safe.

03Our pumping technology services

Our pumping technology services:

  • Consultation and advice
  • Preparation of design documentation
  • Obtaining the relevant building permit
  • Sale of technologies
  • Assembly and installation of the technology
  • Servicing and maintenance
  • Sale of spare parts
